metadata.question: Did over half of the total land area in the Isles Dernières Barrier Islands Refuge become permanently lost to erosion and sea level rise from 2000 to 2024?

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Define Isles Dernières Barrier Islands Refuge area
geom = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-91.2, 29.0, -90.8, 29.4])

# 2. Early period (2000-2005)
early = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') \
    .filterBounds(geom).filterDate('2000-01-01', '2005-12-31') \
    .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 20))
if early.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("No 2000-2005 images, trying Landsat 7")
    early = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2') \
        .filterBounds(geom).filterDate('2000-01-01', '2005-12-31') \
        .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 20))

early_median = early.median().clip(geom)
ndwi_early = early_median.normalizedDifference(['SR_B2', 'SR_B4'])  # Green vs NIR
land_early = ndwi_early.lt(0)  # Water has positive NDWI
area_early = land_early.multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea()).reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=geom, scale=30, maxPixels=1e9).get('constant').getInfo()

# 3. Recent period (2020-2024)
recent = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') \
    .filterBounds(geom).filterDate('2020-01-01', '2024-12-31') \
    .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 20))
if recent.size().getInfo() == 0:
    recent = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2') \
        .filterBounds(geom).filterDate('2020-01-01', '2024-12-31') \
        .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 20))

recent_median = recent.median().clip(geom)
ndwi_recent = recent_median.normalizedDifference(['SR_B3', 'SR_B5'])  # Green vs NIR
land_recent = ndwi_recent.lt(0)
area_recent = land_recent.multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea()).reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=geom, scale=30, maxPixels=1e9).get('constant').getInfo()

if area_early is None or area_recent is None or area_early == 0:
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
else:
    lost_pct = (area_early - area_recent) / area_early * 100
    print(f"Early area: {area_early/1e6:.2f} km2")
    print(f"Recent area: {area_recent/1e6:.2f} km2") 
    print(f"Lost: {lost_pct:.1f}%")
    if lost_pct > 50:
        print("<answer>A</answer>")
    else:
        print("<answer>B</answer>")
